name: When is the best time to purchase a pre-construction property regarding the delivery timeline?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to purchase a pre-construction property regarding the delivery timeline?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 'best' time to purchase a pre-construction property relative to its delivery timeline depends on your personal financial and living situation. Early purchase (during the reservation phase) often offers more choice in units, finishes, and potentially better pricing, but requires a longer wait. Purchasing closer to completion means a shorter wait, but potentially less selection and higher prices. Consider your readiness to wait versus your need for immediate occupancy.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best time to buy depends on your flexibility for waiting versus your need for immediate occupancy and unit selection.
